categories.name: Character Stats and Moodles
categories.description: Hunger, thirst, stress, panic, pain and the rest: every character stat in Build 42.22, how it changes each tick, and how moodles turn the numbers into what you see.

categories.name: Weather, Climate and Seasons

categories.description: How fire starts, spreads and is put out; how the water and the power go off and what still works after; how plumbing, rain barrels and generators behave. Build 42.22, number by number.

categories.description: How fishing and trapping work in Build 42.22, number by number: casting, bites, the tension minigame, fish schools, chum, nets, animal traps, explosive and noise traps, and how a mod adds a fish, a bait or a trap animal.

categories.description: How players build in Build 42.22: the build menu and recipes, placement rules, skill and tool gates, how built objects take damage from zombies, and how moveables are picked up, placed, rotated, broken and scrapped.

categories.name: Stash and Annotated Maps
categories.description: How annotated stash maps work in Build 42.22: where they drop, the odds, what a stash holds, the code behind it, every vanilla stash, and how a mod adds or changes one.
